units.Isaiah 56:1: Thus says the Lord: “Keep justice; do righteousness. For the coming of My salvation has drawn near, and the revealing of My mercy.
units.Isaiah 56:2: Happy is the man who does these things, the person holding fast to them, keeping the Sabbaths from profanation and guarding his hands from wrongdoing.”
units.Isaiah 56:3: Let no foreigner attached to the Lord say, “Will the Lord then separate me from His people?” And let no eunuch say, “I am a dry tree.”
units.Isaiah 56:4: Thus says the Lord: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, choose what I wish, and hold fast to My covenant,
units.Isaiah 56:5: I will give them in My house and wall a renowned place better than sons and daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, and it will not fail.
units.Isaiah 56:6: And the foreigners attached to the Lord, to serve Him and love the Lord’s name, to become His male and female slaves, and all those keeping My Sabbaths from profanation and holding fast to My covenant—
units.Isaiah 56:7: I will bring them into My holy mountain and make them rejoice in My house of prayer. Their whole burnt offerings and sacrifices will be acceptable on My altar, for My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,”
units.Isaiah 56:8: said the Lord who gathers Israel’s scattered people, “for I will gather a gathering to him.”
units.Isaiah 56:9: All you wild beasts, come and eat, all you beasts of the woodland!
units.Isaiah 56:10: See: all have been blinded; they did not know how to think. They are all mute dogs, unable to bark, dreaming of a bed, loving to doze.
units.Isaiah 56:11: The dogs are shameless in appetite, knowing no satisfaction, and they are evil, without understanding. They all followed their own ways, each according to what was his own.
units.Isaiah 57:1: See how the righteous man perished, and no one considers it in his heart. Righteous men are removed, and no one understands. For the righteous man was taken from the presence of injustice.
units.Isaiah 57:2: His burial will be in peace; he has been removed from the midst.
units.Isaiah 57:3: “But you, come forward here, lawless sons, offspring of adulterers and a prostitute!
units.Isaiah 57:4: In whom did you delight? Against whom did you open your mouth and let loose your tongue? Are you not children of destruction, lawless offspring?
units.Isaiah 57:5: You who appeal to idols beneath leafy trees, slaughtering their children in ravines among the rocks!
units.Isaiah 57:6: That is your portion; this is your lot. To those you poured libations, and to those you brought sacrifices. Will I not therefore be angry over these things?
units.Isaiah 57:7: On a high and lofty mountain—there is your bed, and there you brought sacrifices up.
units.Isaiah 57:8: Behind your doorposts you set your memorials. You thought that if you departed from Me you would have something more. You loved those sleeping with you
units.Isaiah 57:9: and multiplied your prostitution with them. You increased the number of those far away from you, sent ambassadors beyond your boundaries, turned away, and were humbled as far as Hades.
units.Isaiah 57:10: You wore yourself out with your many journeys and did not say, ‘I will stop.’ You kept strengthening yourself because you did these things; therefore you did not implore Me—
units.Isaiah 57:11: you! Whom did you reverently fear, that you lied to Me, did not remember Me, and took Me neither into thought nor into your heart? I see you and overlook you, yet you did not fear Me.
units.Isaiah 57:12: I will proclaim My righteousness and your evils, which will not benefit you.
units.Isaiah 57:13: When you cry aloud, let them rescue you in your distress! Wind will take all these, and a storm carry them away. But those holding fast to Me will acquire land and inherit My holy mountain.
units.Isaiah 57:14: They will say, ‘Clear roads before him, and remove obstacles from My people’s road.’
units.Isaiah 57:15: Thus says the Lord Most High, who dwells in the heights for ever, whose name is Holy among holy ones, the Lord Most High resting among holy ones and giving patience to the fainthearted and life to the brokenhearted:
units.Isaiah 57:16: ‘I will not take vengeance on you for ever or always be angry with you. For spirit will go out from Me, and I made every breath.
units.Isaiah 57:17: Because of sin I grieved him a little, struck him, and turned My face away from him. He was grieved and went gloomily along his ways.
units.Isaiah 57:18: I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—
units.Isaiah 57:19: peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’
units.Isaiah 57:20: But the unjust will be tossed by waves in this way and will be unable to rest.
units.Isaiah 57:21: ‘There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,’ said the Lord God.”
units.Isaiah 58:1: “Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.
units.Isaiah 58:2: Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,
units.Isaiah 58:3: saying, ‘Why did we fast, and Thou didst not see? We humbled our lives, and Thou didst not notice?’ For on your fasting days you pursue your wishes and prod all those under your control.
units.Isaiah 58:4: If you fast for lawsuits and fights and strike a humble person with fists, why do you fast for Me as today, to make your voice heard in an outcry?
units.Isaiah 58:5: I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.
units.Isaiah 58:6: ‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.
units.Isaiah 58:7: Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.
units.Isaiah 58:8: Then your light will break out early, and your healings quickly rise. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and God’s glory will enfold you.
units.Isaiah 58:9: Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking He will say, “Behold, I am present.” If you remove from yourself a bond, finger-pointing, and a word of grumbling,
units.Isaiah 58:10: and give bread to the hungry from your heart and satisfy a humbled life, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness be like noon.
units.Isaiah 58:11: Your God will be with you continually, and you will be filled as your life desires. Your bones will grow rich; you will be like a drenched garden and a spring whose water never ran out. Your bones will sprout like grass and grow rich, and they will inherit generations upon generations.
units.Isaiah 58:12: Your ancient deserted places will be rebuilt, and your foundations will endure through generations upon generations. You will be called Builder of Fences, and you will put an end to the paths between.
units.Isaiah 58:13: If you turn your foot away from the Sabbaths, from doing your wishes on the holy day, and call the Sabbaths delightful, holy to your God, you will not lift your foot for work or speak a word in anger from your mouth,
units.Isaiah 58:14: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”
units.Isaiah 59:1: Is the Lord’s hand unable to save? Or has His ear grown heavy so that He cannot hear?
units.Isaiah 59:2: Instead, your offenses stand between you and God, and because of your sins He has turned His face away from you so as not to show mercy.
units.Isaiah 59:3: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates on injustice.
units.Isaiah 59:4: No one speaks what is just, nor is there true judgment. They trust vain things and speak emptiness, for they conceive trouble and give birth to lawlessness.
units.Isaiah 59:5: They broke open asps’ eggs and weave a spider’s web. Whoever was about to eat their eggs broke one and found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk.
units.Isaiah 59:6: Their web will not become clothing, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.
units.Isaiah 59:7: Their feet run to wickedness, quick to shed blood. Their thoughts are the thoughts of fools; destruction and misery lie in their ways.
units.Isaiah 59:8: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their ways. For the paths they travel are twisted, and they do not know peace.
units.Isaiah 59:9: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.
units.Isaiah 59:10: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.
units.Isaiah 59:11: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.
units.Isaiah 59:12: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:
units.Isaiah 59:13: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.
units.Isaiah 59:14: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.
units.Isaiah 59:15: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.
units.Isaiah 59:16: He saw, and there was no man; He considered, and there was no one to help. He defended them with His arm and steadied Himself by mercy.
units.Isaiah 59:17: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, placed a helmet of salvation on His head, and wrapped Himself in a garment of vengeance and the cloak,
units.Isaiah 59:18: as one who will repay recompense—reproach to His adversaries.
units.Isaiah 59:19: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.
units.Isaiah 59:20: The deliverer will come for Zion’s sake and turn ungodliness away from Jacob.
units.Isaiah 59:21: “And this is My covenant with them,” said the Lord: “My spirit that is upon you and the words I put into your mouth will never fail from your mouth or your offspring’s mouth,” for the Lord said, “from now on and for ever.”
units.Isaiah 60:1: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come, and the Lord’s glory has risen upon you.
units.Isaiah 60:2: Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations, but the Lord will appear upon you, and His glory will be seen over you.
units.Isaiah 60:3: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.
units.Isaiah 60:4: Lift your eyes around you and see your children gathered. Behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.
units.Isaiah 60:5: Then you will see and fear and be astonished in heart, for the wealth of sea, nations, and peoples will turn toward you. There will come to you
units.Isaiah 60:6: herds of camels, and camels from Madiam and Gaipha will cover you. They will all come from Saba, bringing gold and carrying frankincense, and they will proclaim the Lord’s salvation as good news.
units.Isaiah 60:7: All Kedar’s sheep will gather to you, and Nabaioth’s rams will come to you. They will be offered acceptably upon My altar, and My house of prayer will be glorified.
units.Isaiah 60:8: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with their young?
units.Isaiah 60:9: Islands waited for Me, and Tharsis ships among the first, to bring your children from far away, with silver and gold, because of the Lord’s holy name and because Israel’s Holy One is glorious.
units.Isaiah 60:10: Foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will attend you. For because of My anger I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.
units.Isaiah 60:11: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring you the nations’ resources and kings being led.
units.Isaiah 60:12: For nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolated.
units.Isaiah 60:13: Lebanon’s glory will come to you in cypress, pine, and cedar together, to glorify My holy place.
units.Isaiah 60:14: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.
units.Isaiah 60:15: Because you became abandoned and hated, with no one helping, I will make you an everlasting exultation, joy for generations upon generations.
units.Isaiah 60:16: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.
units.Isaiah 60:17: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, instead of iron silver, instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. I will appoint your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.
units.Isaiah 60:18: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction and misery within your borders. Your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Engraving.
units.Isaiah 60:19: The sun will not be your light by day, nor will the rising moon light your night. Instead, the Lord will be your everlasting light and God your glory.
units.Isaiah 60:20: For your sun will not set, and your moon will not fail. The Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning will be fulfilled.
units.Isaiah 60:21: Your people will all be righteous, and they will inherit the land for ever, guarding the planting, the works of His hands, for glory.
units.Isaiah 60:22: The fewest will become thousands, and the least a great nation. I, the Lord, will gather them at the proper time.
units.Isaiah 61:1: The Lord’s spirit is upon me, because He anointed me. He sent me to bring good news to the poor, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to the blind,
units.Isaiah 61:2: to announce the Lord’s acceptable year and a day of recompense, to comfort all who mourn,
units.Isaiah 61:3: so that Zion’s mourners may receive glory instead of ashes, an ointment of joy for those who mourn, a robe of glory instead of a spirit of despondency. They will be called Generations of Righteousness, the Lord’s planting, for glory.
units.Isaiah 61:4: They will rebuild age-old deserts and raise places formerly desolated. They will renew deserted cities laid waste for generations.
units.Isaiah 61:5: Foreigners will come shepherding your sheep, and people of other nations will be plowmen and vinedressers.
units.Isaiah 61:6: But you will be called priests of the Lord, ministers of God. You will consume the nations’ resources and be admired in their wealth.
units.Isaiah 61:7: Thus they will inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy will be over their head.
units.Isaiah 61:8: “For I am the Lord who loves righteousness and hates plunder obtained through injustice. I will give their labor’s yield to righteous people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
units.Isaiah 61:9: Their offspring and descendants will be known among nations. Everyone seeing them will recognize them, because they are offspring blessed by God,
units.Isaiah 61:10: and they will rejoice greatly in the Lord.” Let my soul exult in the Lord, for He clothed me in a garment of salvation and a tunic of joy. Like a bridegroom He placed a turban on me, and like a bride He adorned me with ornaments.
units.Isaiah 61:11: As earth increases its flower and a garden its seeds, so the Lord will make righteousness and exultation spring up before all nations.
units.Isaiah 62:1: For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not let up until My righteousness goes out like light and My salvation burns like a torch.
units.Isaiah 62:2: Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory. He will call you your new name, which the Lord will name.
units.Isaiah 62:3: You will be a crown of beauty in the Lord’s hand and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.
units.Isaiah 62:4: You will no longer be called Abandoned, nor will your land be called Desert. You will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.
units.Isaiah 62:5: As a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you. As a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.
units.Isaiah 62:6: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed guards all day and all night, who will never be silent as they remember the Lord.
units.Isaiah 62:7: For there is no one like you, if He restores Jerusalem and makes her a source of pride upon earth.
units.Isaiah 62:8: The Lord swore by His right hand and the strength of His arm: “I will no longer give your grain and food to your enemies, nor will foreigners drink your wine for which you toiled.
units.Isaiah 62:9: Instead, those who gather will eat these things and praise the Lord, and those who gather will drink them in My holy dwellings.”
units.Isaiah 62:10: Go through My gates and make a road for My people. Scatter the stones from the road; raise a signal for the nations!
units.Isaiah 62:11: For behold, the Lord has made it heard to earth’s farthest end: “Tell daughter Zion, ‘Behold, the savior is arriving for you, bringing His own reward and His work before His face.’”
units.Isaiah 62:12: He will call it a holy people redeemed by the Lord; but you will be called a sought-out city, not abandoned.
units.Isaiah 63:1: Who is this arriving from Edom, with redness of garments from Bosor, so beautiful in His robe, with force and strength? “I speak righteousness and saving judgment.”
units.Isaiah 63:2: Why are Thy garments red and Thy clothes as though from a trodden winepress?
units.Isaiah 63:3: “I am full of what has been trodden. No man from the nations is with Me. I trampled them in wrath, crushed them like earth, and brought their blood down to earth.
units.Isaiah 63:4: For a day of recompense came upon them, and a year of redemption is here.
units.Isaiah 63:5: I looked, but there was no helper; I considered, but no one came to aid. My arm rescued them, and My wrath stood by.
units.Isaiah 63:6: I trampled them in My anger and brought their blood down to earth.”
units.Isaiah 63:7: I remembered the Lord’s mercy, the Lord’s excellent deeds in everything He repays us. The Lord is a good judge for Israel’s house; He brings upon us according to His mercy and the abundance of His righteousness.
units.Isaiah 63:8: He said, “Are they not My people, children who will surely not reject Me?” And He became their salvation
units.Isaiah 63:9: from every affliction. Neither an envoy nor an angel, but the Lord Himself saved them because He loved and spared them. He Himself redeemed them, took them up, and exalted them throughout all the days of the age.
units.Isaiah 63:10: But they disobeyed and provoked His holy spirit. He turned toward hostility against them and Himself fought them.
units.Isaiah 63:11: The one who brought the sheep’s shepherd up from earth remembered days of old. Where is the one who placed the holy spirit among them,
units.Isaiah 63:12: who led Moses by the right hand, the arm of His glory? He overpowered water before Him to make Himself an everlasting name.
units.Isaiah 63:13: He led them through the abyss like a horse through a wilderness, and they did not grow weary.
units.Isaiah 63:14: Like livestock through a plain, a spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So Thou didst lead Thy people to make Thyself a glorious name.
units.Isaiah 63:15: Turn from heaven and see from Thy holy and glorious house. Where are Thy zeal and strength? Where is the abundance of Thy mercy and compassion, since Thou hast held back from us?
units.Isaiah 63:16: For Thou art our Father, because Abraham did not know us and Israel did not recognize us. But Thou, Lord, art our Father. Rescue us! From the beginning Thy name has been upon us.
units.Isaiah 63:17: Why, Lord, didst Thou make us stray from Thy way and harden our hearts so that we do not fear Thee? Return because of Thy servants, because of the tribes of Thine inheritance,
units.Isaiah 63:18: so that we may inherit a little of Thy holy mountain. Our adversaries trampled Thy sanctuary.
units.Isaiah 63:19: We became as at the beginning, when Thou didst not rule us and Thy name had not been called upon us. If Thou openest heaven, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee, and they will melt,
units.Isaiah 64:1: like wax melting before fire. Fire will burn up the adversaries, and the Lord’s name will become manifest among the adversaries. Nations will be shaken before Thee.
units.Isaiah 64:2: Whenever Thou dost glorious things, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee.
units.Isaiah 64:3: From of old we have not heard, nor have our eyes seen a god except Thee and Thy works, which Thou wilt do for those awaiting mercy.
units.Isaiah 64:4: For He will meet those doing what is just, and they will remember Thy ways. Behold, Thou becamest angry, and we sinned; therefore we went astray.
units.Isaiah 64:5: We all became like unclean people; all our righteousness is like a menstruating woman’s rag. We fell away like leaves because of our lawless deeds; thus wind will carry us off.
units.Isaiah 64:6: There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.
units.Isaiah 64:7: But now, Lord, Thou art our Father, and we are clay, all the work of Thy hands.
units.Isaiah 64:8: Do not be exceedingly angry with us or remember our sins at the appointed time. And now look, for we are all Thy people.
units.Isaiah 64:9: The city of Thy holy place became a desert; Zion became like a desert, Jerusalem a curse.
units.Isaiah 64:10: The house, our holy place, and the glory our ancestors blessed became fire-burned, and all the glorious things collapsed.
units.Isaiah 64:11: Despite all these things Thou didst hold back, Lord, and keep silent and humble us greatly.
units.Isaiah 65:1: “I became manifest to those not seeking Me; I was found by those not inquiring of Me. I said, ‘Here I am,’ to the nation that did not call My name.
units.Isaiah 65:2: I spread out My hands all day to a disobedient, contradicting people who did not walk in a true way but followed their sins.
units.Isaiah 65:3: This people continually provokes Me to My face. They sacrifice in gardens and burn incense on bricks to demons that do not exist,
units.Isaiah 65:4: and sleep in tombs and caves for dreams. They eat pig’s flesh and sacrificial broth; all their vessels are defiled.
units.Isaiah 65:5: They say, ‘Far away from me! Do not approach me, for I am clean.’ This is smoke of My wrath; fire burns in it all the days.
units.Isaiah 65:6: Behold, it is written before Me: I will not keep silent until I repay into their lap
units.Isaiah 65:7: their sins and their ancestors’ sins,” says the Lord, “who burned incense on mountains and insulted Me on hills. I will repay their works into their lap.”
units.Isaiah 65:8: Thus says the Lord: “As a grape is found in the cluster and people say, ‘Do not ruin it, for the Lord’s blessing is in it,’ so I will act for the sake of the one serving Me; for this one’s sake I will not destroy everyone.
units.Isaiah 65:9: I will bring out the offspring from Jacob and from Judah, and it will inherit My holy mountain. My chosen ones and My slaves will inherit and dwell there.
units.Isaiah 65:10: There will be shelters for flocks in the woodland, and the ravine of Achor will be a resting place for cattle, for My people who sought Me.
units.Isaiah 65:11: But you who abandoned Me and forget My holy mountain, preparing a table for the demon and filling a mixed drink for Fortune,
units.Isaiah 65:12: I will hand you over to the sword; all of you will fall in slaughter, because I called you and you did not obey, I spoke and you disregarded Me. You did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”
units.Isaiah 65:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: “Behold, those serving Me will eat, but you will hunger. Those serving Me will drink, but you will thirst. Those serving Me will rejoice, but you will be ashamed.
units.Isaiah 65:14: Behold, those serving Me will exult with joy, but you will cry out because of your heart’s pain and wail from a broken spirit.
units.Isaiah 65:15: For you will leave your name as a surfeit for My chosen ones, but the Lord will put you to death. Those serving Him will be called a new name,
units.Isaiah 65:16: which will be blessed upon earth. For they will bless the true God, and those swearing upon earth will swear by the true God. They will forget their former affliction, and it will not rise into their heart.
units.Isaiah 65:17: For heaven will be new and earth new, and they will never remember former things, nor will those things enter their heart,
units.Isaiah 65:18: but they will find joy and exultation in it. For behold, I am making Jerusalem an exultation and My people joy.
units.Isaiah 65:19: I will exult over Jerusalem and rejoice over My people, and no sound of weeping or crying will ever again be heard in her.
units.Isaiah 65:20: There will never be one cut off prematurely there, nor an old man who fails to complete his time. For the young person will be a hundred years old, but the sinner who dies will be a hundred years old and accursed.
units.Isaiah 65:21: They will build houses and inhabit them themselves; they will plant vineyards and eat their own produce.
units.Isaiah 65:22: They will not build for others to inhabit or plant for others to eat. For My people’s days will be like those of the tree of life; they will wear out the works of their labor.
units.Isaiah 65:23: My chosen ones will not labor in vain or bear children for a curse, because they are offspring blessed by God, and their descendants will be with them.
units.Isaiah 65:24: Before they cry out I will listen to them; while they are still speaking I will say, ‘What is it?’
units.Isaiah 65:25: Then wolves and lambs will graze together, and a lion will eat straw like an ox, while a serpent will eat earth like bread. They will not wrong or destroy on My holy mountain,” says the Lord.
units.Isaiah 66:1: Thus says the Lord: “Heaven is My throne, and earth the footstool of My feet. What sort of house will you build for Me, or what place is My rest?
units.Isaiah 66:2: For My hand made all these things, and all these things are Mine,” says the Lord. “And to whom will I look except the humble and quiet one who trembles at My words?
units.Isaiah 66:3: But the lawless person who sacrifices a calf to Me is like someone killing a dog; the one offering fine flour is like one offering pig’s blood; the one giving frankincense as a memorial is like a blasphemer. These people chose their ways and their abominations, which their soul desired,
units.Isaiah 66:4: and I will choose their mockeries and repay their sins to them, because I called them and they did not obey Me, I spoke and they did not hear. They did evil before Me and chose what I did not want.”
units.Isaiah 66:5: Hear the Lord’s word, you who tremble at His word! Speak, our brothers, to those who hate us and loathe us, so that the Lord’s name may be glorified and seen in their rejoicing; and those people will be ashamed.
units.Isaiah 66:6: A sound of shouting from the city, a sound from the temple, the sound of the Lord repaying recompense to His opponents!
units.Isaiah 66:7: Before the woman in labor gave birth, before the pain of labor came, she escaped and bore a male.
units.Isaiah 66:8: Who heard such a thing, and who has seen anything like it? Did a land labor in one day, or was a nation born all at once? For Zion labored and bore her children.
units.Isaiah 66:9: ‘But I gave this expectation, and you did not remember Me,’ said the Lord. ‘Behold, did I not make the woman who gives birth and the barren woman?’ said God.
units.Isaiah 66:10: Rejoice, Jerusalem, and celebrate in her, all who love her! Rejoice with joy, all who mourn over her,
units.Isaiah 66:11: so that you may nurse and be filled from her comforting breast, so that, nursing fully, you may delight in the entrance of her glory.
units.Isaiah 66:12: For thus says the Lord: ‘Behold, I turn toward them like a river of peace, and like a flooding torrent the glory of nations. Their children will be lifted on shoulders and comforted on knees.
units.Isaiah 66:13: As if a mother were to comfort someone, so I too will comfort you, and in Jerusalem you will be comforted.’
units.Isaiah 66:14: You will see, and your heart will rejoice; your bones will spring up like vegetation. The Lord’s hand will be known to those who revere Him, and He will threaten the disobedient.
units.Isaiah 66:15: For behold, the Lord will come like fire, and His chariots like a storm, to render vengeance in wrath and rejection in a flame of fire.
units.Isaiah 66:16: For by the Lord’s fire all the earth will be judged, and by His sword all flesh; many will be wounded by the Lord.
units.Isaiah 66:17: ‘Those purifying and cleansing themselves for the gardens, eating pig’s flesh and abominations and the mouse in the porches, will be consumed together,’ said the Lord,
units.Isaiah 66:18: ‘and I know their works and their reasoning. I am coming to gather all nations and languages, and they will come and see My glory.
units.Isaiah 66:19: I will leave signs upon them and send those saved from them to the nations: to Tharsis, Phoud, Loud, Mosoch, Thobel and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard My name or seen My glory. They will announce My glory among the nations.
units.Isaiah 66:20: They will bring your brothers from all nations as a gift to the Lord, with horses and chariots, in mule carriages with sunshades, to the holy city Jerusalem,’ said the Lord, ‘as the Israelites might bring Me their sacrifices with psalms into the Lord’s house.
units.Isaiah 66:21: From them I will take priests and Levites for Myself,’ said the Lord.
units.Isaiah 66:22: ‘For just as the new heaven and new earth that I make remain before Me,’ says the Lord, ‘so your offspring and your name will stand.

source_units.display_text: Thus says the Lord Most High, who dwells in the heights for ever, whose name is Holy among holy ones, the Lord Most High resting among holy ones and giving patience to the fainthearted and life to the brokenhearted:

source_units.text: ‘I will not take vengeance on you for ever or always be angry with you. For spirit will go out from Me, and I made every breath.
source_units.display_text: ‘I will not take vengeance on you for ever or always be angry with you. For spirit will go out from Me, and I made every breath.

source_units.text: Because of sin I grieved him a little, struck him, and turned My face away from him. He was grieved and went gloomily along his ways.
source_units.display_text: Because of sin I grieved him a little, struck him, and turned My face away from him. He was grieved and went gloomily along his ways.

source_units.text: I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—
source_units.display_text: I have seen his ways, healed him, comforted him, and given him true comfort—

source_units.text: peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’
source_units.display_text: peace upon peace to those far away and those near. And the Lord said, ‘I will heal them.’

source_units.text: ‘There is no rejoicing for the ungodly,’ said the Lord God.”

source_units.text: “Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.
source_units.display_text: “Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.

source_units.text: Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,
source_units.display_text: Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,

source_units.text: saying, ‘Why did we fast, and Thou didst not see? We humbled our lives, and Thou didst not notice?’ For on your fasting days you pursue your wishes and prod all those under your control.
source_units.display_text: saying, ‘Why did we fast, and Thou didst not see? We humbled our lives, and Thou didst not notice?’ For on your fasting days you pursue your wishes and prod all those under your control.

source_units.text: If you fast for lawsuits and fights and strike a humble person with fists, why do you fast for Me as today, to make your voice heard in an outcry?
source_units.display_text: If you fast for lawsuits and fights and strike a humble person with fists, why do you fast for Me as today, to make your voice heard in an outcry?

source_units.text: I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.
source_units.display_text: I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.

source_units.text: ‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.
source_units.display_text: ‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.

source_units.text: Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.
source_units.display_text: Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.

source_units.text: Then your light will break out early, and your healings quickly rise. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and God’s glory will enfold you.
source_units.display_text: Then your light will break out early, and your healings quickly rise. Your righteousness will go ahead of you, and God’s glory will enfold you.

source_units.text: Then you will cry, and God will hear you. While you are still speaking He will say, “Behold, I am present.” If you remove from yourself a bond, finger-pointing, and a word of grumbling,

source_units.text: and give bread to the hungry from your heart and satisfy a humbled life, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness be like noon.
source_units.display_text: and give bread to the hungry from your heart and satisfy a humbled life, then your light will rise in darkness, and your darkness be like noon.

source_units.text: Your God will be with you continually, and you will be filled as your life desires. Your bones will grow rich; you will be like a drenched garden and a spring whose water never ran out. source_units.display_text: Your God will be with you continually, and you will be filled as your life desires. source_units.text: Your ancient deserted places will be rebuilt, and your foundations will endure through generations upon generations. You will be called Builder of Fences, and you will put an end to the paths between.
source_units.display_text: Your ancient deserted places will be rebuilt, and your foundations will endure through generations upon generations. You will be called Builder of Fences, and you will put an end to the paths between.

source_units.text: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”
source_units.display_text: and you will trust in the Lord. He will bring you up to earth’s good things and feed you your father Jacob’s inheritance, for the Lord’s mouth has spoken these things.’”

source_units.display_text: Is the Lord’s hand unable to save? Or has His ear grown heavy so that He cannot hear?

source_units.text: Instead, your offenses stand between you and God, and because of your sins He has turned His face away from you so as not to show mercy.
source_units.display_text: Instead, your offenses stand between you and God, and because of your sins He has turned His face away from you so as not to show mercy.

source_units.text: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates on injustice.
source_units.display_text: For your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with sins. Your lips spoke lawlessness, and your tongue meditates on injustice.

source_units.text: No one speaks what is just, nor is there true judgment. They trust vain things and speak emptiness, for they conceive trouble and give birth to lawlessness.
source_units.display_text: No one speaks what is just, nor is there true judgment. They trust vain things and speak emptiness, for they conceive trouble and give birth to lawlessness.

source_units.text: They broke open asps’ eggs and weave a spider’s web. Whoever was about to eat their eggs broke one and found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk.
source_units.display_text: They broke open asps’ eggs and weave a spider’s web. Whoever was about to eat their eggs broke one and found a wind-egg, and in it a basilisk.

source_units.text: Their web will not become clothing, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.
source_units.display_text: Their web will not become clothing, nor will they clothe themselves from their works, for their works are works of lawlessness.

source_units.text: Their feet run to wickedness, quick to shed blood. Their thoughts are the thoughts of fools; destruction and misery lie in their ways.
source_units.display_text: Their feet run to wickedness, quick to shed blood. Their thoughts are the thoughts of fools; destruction and misery lie in their ways.

source_units.text: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their ways. For the paths they travel are twisted, and they do not know peace.
source_units.display_text: They do not know the way of peace, and there is no justice in their ways. For the paths they travel are twisted, and they do not know peace.

source_units.text: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.
source_units.display_text: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.

source_units.text: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.
source_units.display_text: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.

source_units.text: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.
source_units.display_text: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.

source_units.text: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:
source_units.display_text: For our lawlessness is great before Thee, and our sins have opposed us. Our lawless deeds are within us, and we have recognized our wrongs:

source_units.text: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.
source_units.display_text: We acted impiously and lied and withdrew from following our God. We spoke unjust things and disobeyed; we conceived and meditated on unjust words from our heart.

source_units.text: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.
source_units.display_text: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.

source_units.text: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.
source_units.display_text: Truth has been taken away, and they turned their mind away from understanding. The Lord saw, and it did not please Him that there was no judgment.

source_units.text: He saw, and there was no man; He considered, and there was no one to help. He defended them with His arm and steadied Himself by mercy.
source_units.display_text: He saw, and there was no man; He considered, and there was no one to help. He defended them with His arm and steadied Himself by mercy.

source_units.text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, placed a helmet of salvation on His head, and wrapped Himself in a garment of vengeance and the cloak,
source_units.display_text: He put on righteousness like a breastplate, placed a helmet of salvation on His head, and wrapped Himself in a garment of vengeance and the cloak,

source_units.text: as one who will repay recompense—reproach to His adversaries.
source_units.display_text: as one who will repay recompense—reproach to His adversaries.

source_units.text: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.
source_units.display_text: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.

source_units.text: The deliverer will come for Zion’s sake and turn ungodliness away from Jacob.
source_units.display_text: The deliverer will come for Zion’s sake and turn ungodliness away from Jacob.

source_units.text: “And this is My covenant with them,” said the Lord: “My spirit that is upon you and the words I put into your mouth will never fail from your mouth or your offspring’s mouth,” for the Lord said, “from now on and for ever.”
source_units.display_text: “And this is My covenant with them,” said the Lord: “My spirit that is upon you and the words I put into your mouth will never fail from your mouth or your offspring’s mouth,” for the Lord said, “from now on and for ever.”

source_units.text: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come, and the Lord’s glory has risen upon you.
source_units.display_text: Shine, shine, Jerusalem, for your light has come, and the Lord’s glory has risen upon you.

source_units.text: Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations, but the Lord will appear upon you, and His glory will be seen over you.
source_units.display_text: Behold, darkness and gloom will cover earth over nations, but the Lord will appear upon you, and His glory will be seen over you.

source_units.text: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.
source_units.display_text: Kings will walk by your light, and nations by your radiance.

source_units.text: Lift your eyes around you and see your children gathered. Behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.
source_units.display_text: Lift your eyes around you and see your children gathered. Behold, all your sons have come from far away, and your daughters will be lifted upon shoulders.

source_units.text: Then you will see and fear and be astonished in heart, for the wealth of sea, nations, and peoples will turn toward you. There will come to you
source_units.display_text: Then you will see and fear and be astonished in heart, for the wealth of sea, nations, and peoples will turn toward you. There will come to you

source_units.display_text: herds of camels, and camels from Madiam and Gaipha will cover you. They will all come from Saba, bringing gold and carrying frankincense, and they will proclaim the Lord’s salvation as good news.

source_units.display_text: All Kedar’s sheep will gather to you, and Nabaioth’s rams will come to you. They will be offered acceptably upon My altar, and My house of prayer will be glorified.

source_units.text: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with their young?
source_units.display_text: Who are these flying like clouds and like doves with their young?

source_units.text: Islands waited for Me, and Tharsis ships among the first, to bring your children from far away, with silver and gold, because of the Lord’s holy name and because Israel’s Holy One is glorious.
source_units.display_text: Islands waited for Me, and Tharsis ships among the first, to bring your children from far away, with silver and gold, because of the Lord’s holy name and because Israel’s Holy One is glorious.

source_units.text: Foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will attend you. For because of My anger I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.
source_units.display_text: Foreigners will build your walls, and their kings will attend you. For because of My anger I struck you, and because of mercy I loved you.

source_units.text: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring you the nations’ resources and kings being led.
source_units.display_text: Your gates will be opened continually; day and night they will not be shut, to bring you the nations’ resources and kings being led.

source_units.text: For nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolated.
source_units.display_text: For nations and kings who will not serve you will perish, and the nations will be utterly desolated.

source_units.text: Lebanon’s glory will come to you in cypress, pine, and cedar together, to glorify My holy place.
source_units.display_text: Lebanon’s glory will come to you in cypress, pine, and cedar together, to glorify My holy place.

source_units.text: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.
source_units.display_text: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.

source_units.text: Because you became abandoned and hated, with no one helping, I will make you an everlasting exultation, joy for generations upon generations.
source_units.display_text: Because you became abandoned and hated, with no one helping, I will make you an everlasting exultation, joy for generations upon generations.

source_units.text: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.
source_units.display_text: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.

source_units.text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, instead of iron silver, instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. I will appoint your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.
source_units.display_text: Instead of bronze I will bring you gold, instead of iron silver, instead of wood bronze, and instead of stones iron. I will appoint your rulers in peace and your overseers in righteousness.

source_units.text: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction and misery within your borders. Your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Engraving.
source_units.display_text: Injustice will no longer be heard in your land, nor destruction and misery within your borders. Your walls will be called Salvation, and your gates Engraving.

source_units.text: The sun will not be your light by day, nor will the rising moon light your night. Instead, the Lord will be your everlasting light and God your glory.
source_units.display_text: The sun will not be your light by day, nor will the rising moon light your night. Instead, the Lord will be your everlasting light and God your glory.

source_units.text: For your sun will not set, and your moon will not fail. The Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning will be fulfilled.
source_units.display_text: For your sun will not set, and your moon will not fail. The Lord will be your everlasting light, and your days of mourning will be fulfilled.

source_units.text: Your people will all be righteous, and they will inherit the land for ever, guarding the planting, the works of His hands, for glory.
source_units.display_text: Your people will all be righteous, and they will inherit the land for ever, guarding the planting, the works of His hands, for glory.

source_units.text: The fewest will become thousands, and the least a great nation. I, the Lord, will gather them at the proper time.
source_units.display_text: The fewest will become thousands, and the least a great nation. I, the Lord, will gather them at the proper time.

source_units.text: The Lord’s spirit is upon me, because He anointed me. He sent me to bring good news to the poor, to heal the brokenhearted, to proclaim release to captives and recovery of sight to the blind,

source_units.display_text: They will rebuild age-old deserts and raise places formerly desolated. They will renew deserted cities laid waste for generations.

source_units.display_text: Foreigners will come shepherding your sheep, and people of other nations will be plowmen and vinedressers.

source_units.display_text: “For I am the Lord who loves righteousness and hates plunder obtained through injustice. I will give their labor’s yield to righteous people and make an everlasting covenant with them.

source_units.display_text: For Zion I will not be silent, and for Jerusalem I will not let up until My righteousness goes out like light and My salvation burns like a torch.

source_units.display_text: Nations will see your righteousness and kings your glory. He will call you your new name, which the Lord will name.

source_units.display_text: You will be a crown of beauty in the Lord’s hand and a royal diadem in your God’s hand.

source_units.display_text: You will no longer be called Abandoned, nor will your land be called Desert. You will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.

source_units.display_text: As a young man lives with a virgin, so your sons will dwell with you. As a bridegroom rejoices over a bride, so the Lord will rejoice over you.

source_units.display_text: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed guards all day and all night, who will never be silent as they remember the Lord.

source_units.display_text: For there is no one like you, if He restores Jerusalem and makes her a source of pride upon earth.

source_units.display_text: The Lord swore by His right hand and the strength of His arm: “I will no longer give your grain and food to your enemies, nor will foreigners drink your wine for which you toiled.

source_units.display_text: Instead, those who gather will eat these things and praise the Lord, and those who gather will drink them in My holy dwellings.”

source_units.display_text: Who is this arriving from Edom, with redness of garments from Bosor, so beautiful in His robe, with force and strength? “I speak righteousness and saving judgment.”

amended_triples.relationship: related rebuke of self-serving appetite
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah condemns insatiable dogs who each follow their own ways; Ezekiel rebukes shepherds consuming milk, clothing themselves with wool and slaughtering fattened animals while not feeding God's sheep. The rebukes use different animal images and roles to expose appetite directed toward oneself.
amended_triples.source_text: The dogs are shameless in appetite, knowing no satisfaction, and they are evil, without understanding. They all followed their own ways, each according to what was his own.

target_units.text: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s shepherds. Prophesy and say to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, surely shepherds do not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed the sheep?
Behold, you consume the milk, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fattened animal, but you do not feed My sheep.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel condemnation of child sacrifice in a ravine
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah condemns slaughtering children in ravines among rocks while appealing to idols; Jeremiah names Topheth in Hinnom's ravine, where children were burned contrary to God's command. Jeremiah specifies the location and method more narrowly than Isaiah's unit does.
amended_triples.source_text: You who appeal to idols beneath leafy trees, slaughtering their children in ravines among the rocks!

target_units.text: And they built Topheth’s altar, which is in the ravine of the son of Hinnom, to burn up their sons and daughters in fire, which I did not command them and did not conceive in My heart.

amended_triples.relationship: close expectation of light overtaken by darkness
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah describes people waiting for light but encountering darkness; Jeremiah warns that people will wait for light but find death's shadow and darkness. The two passages use the same frustrated expectation in different settings.
amended_triples.source_text: Therefore judgment withdrew from them, and righteousness will not reach them. While they waited for light, darkness came to them; waiting for dawn, they walked in an untimely darkness.

target_units.text: Give glory to the Lord your God before darkness comes and before your feet stumble on dark mountains; you will wait for light, and there is death’s shadow, and they will be placed in darkness.

amended_triples.relationship: close blind groping and failure at midday
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah describes groping like blind people and falling at midday as at midnight; Deuteronomy's curse describes groping at midday like a blind person in darkness. Isaiah's description supplies a concrete counterpart to the curse's imagery.
amended_triples.source_text: They will grope along a wall like the blind, and as though without eyes they will grope. They will fall at noon as at midnight; like people dying, they will groan.

target_units.text: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and He shall not prosper your ways; and you shall be wronged and plundered all your days, and there shall be none to help you.

amended_triples.relationship: related lament over absent judgment and rescue
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah describes waiting for judgment and salvation that remain absent; Habakkuk cries to the Lord while wronged and asks why He does not listen or save. Habakkuk explicitly cries, while Isaiah's unit uses bears and traveling doves.
amended_triples.source_text: Like a bear and like a dove they will travel together. We waited for judgment, but there is none; salvation has withdrawn far from us.

target_units.text: How long, Lord, shall I cry and Thou wilt not listen? I shall cry to Thee while being wronged, and Thou wilt not save?

amended_triples.relationship: parallel judgment prevented and distorted by wrongdoing
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah's speakers say they drove judgment backward, while righteousness withdrew far away; Habakkuk says judgment is not completed and goes out distorted as the impious oppress the righteous. Their descriptions portray justice's failure through different movements.
amended_triples.source_text: We drove judgment backward, and righteousness has withdrawn far away, for truth was consumed in their ways, and they could not go straight through.

target_units.text: Therefore law has been scattered, and judgment is not brought to completion; the impious oppresses the righteous, so judgment will go forth distorted.

amended_triples.relationship: close worldwide recognition of the Lord's name
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah joins the west and sunrise with fear of the Lord's name and glory; Malachi says His name is glorified among nations from sunrise to sunset. Malachi adds incense and pure sacrifice; Isaiah describes anger from the Lord coming like a violent river.
amended_triples.source_text: Those from the west will fear the Lord’s name, and those from sunrise the glorious name. For anger from the Lord will come like a violent river; it will come with wrath.

target_units.text: “For from the sun’s rising to its setting, My name has been glorified among the nations, and in every place incense is brought to My name, together with a pure sacrifice, because My name is great among the nations,” says the Lord Almighty.

amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah 60 describes oppressors' sons coming in fear; Isaiah 49 describes kings and ruling women bowing and licking dust at the city's feet. The groups and postures differ, while the city's restored standing and recognition of the Lord connect the promises.
amended_triples.source_text: The sons of those who humbled and provoked you will come to you in fear. You will be called the Lord’s City, Zion of Israel’s Holy One.

target_units.text: and kings will be your foster fathers and ruling women your nurses. They will bow to you upon the earth’s surface and lick the dust of your feet. You will know that I am the Lord, and you will not be ashamed.

amended_triples.relationship: close recognition of the Lord as Israel's rescuer
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah 60 names Israel's God as the One saving and delivering the city; Isaiah 49 names the Lord as rescuer and upholder of Jacob's strength. The recognition follows nations' milk and kings' wealth in the former and enemies' defeat in the latter.

target_units.text: Those who afflicted you will eat their own flesh, drink their own blood like new wine, and become drunk. All flesh will perceive that I am the Lord who rescued you and upholds Jacob’s strength.”

amended_triples.relationship: internal righteous government accompanying Zion's restoration
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah 60 promises rulers in peace and overseers in righteousness; Isaiah 1 restores judges and counselors and names Zion the City of Righteousness. The offices and expressions of their proper order differ.

target_units.text: I will establish your judges as before and your counselors as at the beginning. After these things you will be called City of Righteousness, Faithful Metropolis Zion.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel clothing with salvation accompanied by rejoicing
amended_triples.rationale: The speaker in Isaiah rejoices in God's clothing him with a garment of salvation and tunic of joy; the psalm promises Zion's priests clothing with salvation and her holy ones exultation. Isaiah further develops bridegroom and bride adornment.
amended_triples.source_text: and they will rejoice greatly in the Lord.” Let my soul exult in the Lord, for He clothed me in a garment of salvation and a tunic of joy. Like a bridegroom He placed a turban on me, and like a bride He adorned me with ornaments.

target_units.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her holy ones will surely exult.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel changed names expressing renewed divine belonging
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah replaces Abandoned and Desert with My Desire and Inhabited; Hosea reverses Not Shown Mercy and Not My People through mercy and belonging. The names differ while each reversal expresses restored relationship with God.
amended_triples.source_text: You will no longer be called Abandoned, nor will your land be called Desert. You will be called My Desire, and your land Inhabited.

target_units.text: I will sow her for Myself upon the land, show mercy to Not Shown Mercy and say to Not My People, ‘You are My people.’ He will say, ‘Thou art the Lord my God!’”

amended_triples.relationship: related day-and-night remembrance and appeal to God
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah's appointed guards are never silent day or night as they remember the Lord; Luke describes God's chosen ones crying to Him day and night for justice. Luke's surrounding parable explicitly teaches persistent prayer.
amended_triples.source_text: Upon your walls, Jerusalem, I appointed guards all day and all night, who will never be silent as they remember the Lord.

target_units.text: And will not God bring about justice for His chosen ones who cry to Him day and night? And will He delay over them?

amended_triples.relationship: parallel enjoying the produce of one's own labor
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah promises that those gathering will eat and drink their produce; the psalm promises eating the labors of one's own hands. Isaiah additionally names praise and drinking in God's holy dwellings.
amended_triples.source_text: Instead, those who gather will eat these things and praise the Lord, and those who gather will drink them in My holy dwellings.”

target_units.text: You will eat the labors of your wrists; happy are you, and it will be well with you.

amended_triples.relationship: close announcement to daughter Zion of a saving arrival
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah tells daughter Zion that her Savior comes; Zechariah tells daughter Zion her king comes, righteous and saving. Zechariah specifies the king's gentleness and mount, which Isaiah does not name here.
amended_triples.source_text: For behold, the Lord has made it heard to earth’s farthest end: “Tell daughter Zion, ‘Behold, the savior is arriving for you, bringing His own reward and His work before His face.’”

target_units.text: Rejoice greatly, daughter Zion; proclaim, daughter Jerusalem. Behold, your king comes to you, righteous and saving, gentle, and mounted upon a beast of burden and a young colt.

amended_triples.relationship: close internal coming with reward and work before Him
amended_triples.rationale: Both announce an arrival with reward and work before the coming figure. Isaiah 62 tells daughter Zion that the savior is arriving; Isaiah 40 names the Lord and emphasizes might and dominion.
amended_triples.source_text: For behold, the Lord has made it heard to earth’s farthest end: “Tell daughter Zion, ‘Behold, the savior is arriving for you, bringing His own reward and His work before His face.’”

target_units.text: Behold, the Lord comes with might, and His arm with dominion; behold, His reward is with Him, and His work before Him.

amended_triples.relationship: close the Lord's Spirit guiding on level terrain
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah compares the Spirit's guidance to livestock passing through a plain; the psalm declares that God's good Spirit will lead the speaker on level ground. The collective remembrance and personal declaration share the guiding Spirit and terrain image.
amended_triples.source_text: Like livestock through a plain, a spirit from the Lord came down and guided them. So Thou didst lead Thy people to make Thyself a glorious name.

target_units.text: Teach me to do Thy will, for Thou art my God. Thy good Spirit will lead me on level ground.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel divine manifestation shaking mountains
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah imagines heaven opened and mountains trembling and melting before God; Micah describes the Lord descending, mountains shaken and valleys melting. The particular terrain that melts differs.
amended_triples.source_text: We became as at the beginning, when Thou didst not rule us and Thy name had not been called upon us. If Thou openest heaven, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee, and they will melt,

target_units.text: For look, the Lord is coming out of His place; He will descend and step upon the heights of the earth,
and the mountains will be shaken beneath Him, and the valleys will melt like wax before fire and like water flowing downhill.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel mountains responding to God's manifestation
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah says glorious divine acts bring trembling upon mountains; Habakkuk describes God standing and looking, followed by the earth shaking and mountains being violently crushed. Their precise descriptions of the mountains' response differ.
amended_triples.source_text: Whenever Thou dost glorious things, trembling will seize mountains because of Thee.

target_units.text: He stood, and the earth shook; He looked, and nations melted. Mountains were crushed violently; everlasting hills melted.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel absence of people seeking God
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah laments no one calling God's name or remembering to hold to Him; the psalm describes God looking for anyone seeking Him, followed by all turning aside. Isaiah additionally describes God's turned face and His handing the people over because of sins.
amended_triples.source_text: There is no one calling on Thy name or remembering to take hold of Thee, because Thou didst turn Thy face away from us and didst hand us over because of our sins.

target_units.text: The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks God.

All turned aside; together they became useless; there is no one who shows kindness, not even one. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit. The venom of asps is under their lips; their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness. Their feet are swift to shed blood; brokenness and misery are in their ways, and they did not know a way of peace. There is no fear of God before their eyes.

amended_triples.relationship: parallel the Lord's voice sounding from Jerusalem
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah announces the Lord's recompense in sounds from the city and temple; Amos describes the Lord speaking from Zion and giving His voice from Jerusalem, with the countryside mourning. The venue and divine voice correspond while their effects differ.
amended_triples.source_text: A sound of shouting from the city, a sound from the temple, the sound of the Lord repaying recompense to His opponents!

target_units.text: He said: “The Lord spoke from Zion and gave His voice from Jerusalem; the shepherds’ pastures mourned, and Carmel’s summit dried up.”

amended_triples.relationship: internal milk imagery for the city's abundance
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah 66 depicts people nursing from Jerusalem's comforting breast; Isaiah 60 depicts Jerusalem drinking nations' milk and eating kings' wealth. The city receives abundance in the earlier image and nourishes her people in the later one.
amended_triples.source_text: so that you may nurse and be filled from her comforting breast, so that, nursing fully, you may delight in the entrance of her glory.

target_units.text: You will suck the nations’ milk and eat kings’ wealth. You will know that I am the Lord who saves and delivers you, Israel’s God.

amended_triples.relationship: related mission among those not previously hearing the divine message
amended_triples.rationale: Isaiah describes God sending saved people to nations and islands that have not heard His name or seen His glory; Paul describes proclaiming Christ where He was not named and quotes a promise to those who had not heard. The letter's quoted wording is not presented as a verbatim citation of this Isaiah unit.
amended_triples.source_text: I will leave signs upon them and send those saved from them to the nations: to Tharsis, Phoud, Loud, Mosoch, Thobel and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard My name or seen My glory. They will announce My glory among the nations.

target_units.text: and so making it my ambition to proclaim the gospel where Christ has not been named, so that I would not build on another’s foundation,
but just as it is written, “Those to whom nothing about Him was announced will see, and those who have not heard will understand.”
